body.voice_description: Create an original cartoon chess-coach voice. Character: Quiet ghost watcher; notices a supported danger without melodrama. Slightly eerie, still useful and intelligible. Voice direction: Middle female register with a slight Swedish accent and dry delicate reed texture. Tiny irregular inflections, calm clear words and a gently uncanny lightness. Neither a breathy soprano nor a deep ghost rumble. Fluent spoken English, with the requested accent. Normal conversational pace with clear teaching emphasis; aim for an eight-to-ten-second passage without long dramatic pauses. Clean, dry studio recording, one intelligible voice, no music, background noise or animal sounds. Finish the final word completely with a natural settled ending. An original character voice, not an imitation of a named person or existing character.
